map.由现值、利率与年数求投资未来值 使用指南: Investment Future Value from Present Value, Rate and Years User Guide
map.输入本金现值 PV、年利率 r 与投资年数 n，按 FV = PV·(1+r)ⁿ: Enter principal present value PV, annual rate r and investment years n, and compute the compounded future value as FV = PV*(1+r)^n, for estimating maturity returns on deposits, wealth management and other one-off investments.
map.输入现值 PV、年利率 r 与年数 n，求未来值。: Enter present value PV, annual rate r and number of years n to find the future value.
map.一次性本金按复利算未来值。: Compute the future value of a one-off principal at compound interest.
map.对比不同利率/年限的增值。: Compare growth under different rates or terms.
map.一次性投入后按复利滚动，估算到期的本息合计。: After a one-off investment, roll it up at compound interest to estimate the total principal and interest at maturity.
map.：FV = 10000×1.08¹⁰ = 10000×2.1589 ≈ 2158: : FV = 10000 x 1.08^10 = 10000 x 2.1589, about 21589 CNY. That is, 10,000 at 8% compound for 10 years becomes about 21,600.
map.本金 50000 元，年利率 6%，投资 10 年: Principal 50,000 CNY, annual rate 6%, invested for 10 years
map.：FV=50000×(1.06)¹⁰≈89542.38 元，其中利息 39542: : FV = 50000 x (1.06)^10, about 89542.38 CNY, of which interest is 39542.38 CNY, already more than 79% of the principal.
map.由多期收益率序列求几何平均收益率: Geometric mean return from a multi-period return series
map.使 NPV = 0 的贴现率: The discount rate that makes NPV = 0
map.复利和单利差多少？: How much difference is there between compound and simple interest?
map.单利 10 年只 1.8 万；复利 2.16 万，利息再生息的差距随年限放大。: Simple interest over 10 years gives only 18,000, while compound interest gives 21,600; the gap from interest earning interest widens with the term.
map.按年计息换成按月计息怎么算？: How do you switch from annual to monthly compounding?
map.把年利率除以计息次数、期数乘以计息次数：按月复利为 FV=PV(1+r/12)^: Divide the annual rate by the number of compounding periods and multiply the number of periods by the same: monthly compounding gives FV = PV(1+r/12)^(12n). The example above with monthly compounding is about 90969.84 CNY, 1427.46 CNY more than annual.
